translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Ndieti zola Yave bila niandi weti wa mbemboꞌama
weti wa yamikina kuama mu diambu di kiadi.
Bila niandi wutamba dikutu diandi kuidi minu,
ndiela kuntela sumbu ndilembo zingi.
Minsinga mi lufua mimfietikisa ;
tsisi yi tsi yi bafua yibua va minu ;
ndibedoso kuidi ziphasi ayi maniongo.
Buna nditedila dizina di Yave ;
“A Yave, wuphukisa !”
Yave widi nkua nlemvo ayi widi wusonga ;
Nzambi eto widi nkua kiadi.
Yave wunkebanga batu badi bakuluka mu mintima ;
bu ndiba mu nkinza wu ngolo niandi wuphukisa.
Ba mu luvundulu mu zithangu ziwombo, a muelꞌama
bila Yave wuba wumboti kuidi ngeyo.
Bila ngeyo, a Yave, wukula muelꞌama mu lufua ;
meso mama mu matsuela,
malu mama mu bumina thutu
muingi ndibaka bu diatila va ntuala Yave,
va mbata ntoto wu batu badi moyo.
Ndiwilukila, diawu nditubila :
“mu ziphasi zingolo ndidi.”
Ku tsi maniongo mama ndituba :
“batu boso badi bankua luvunu.”
Buevi ndilendi futila Yave
mu mamboti mandi moso kuidi minu e ?
Ndiela vumuna mbungu yi phulusu
ayi ndiela tela dizina di Yave.
Ndiela dukisa zindefi ziama zioso kuidi Yave ;
va meso ma batu bandi boso.
Lufua lu banlongo ba Yave
thalu luidi va meso mandi.
A Yave, bukiedika ndidi kisadi kiaku ;
ndidi kisadi kiaku, muana wu kisadi kiaku ki nketo.
Ngeyo wukhula mu zisieni ziama.
Ndiela kutambika makaba ma phutudulu matondo
ayi ndiela tela dizina di Yave.
Ndiela dukisa zindefi ziama zioso kuidi Yave ;
va meso ma batu bandi boso,
mu zimpangu zi Nzo Yave,
va khatitsikꞌaku ngeyo Yelusalemi.
Luzitisa Yave.
